verdict.rationale: Fin's own docs say it runs inside Intercom and in third-party helpdesks: there are dedicated Zendesk and Salesforce integration articles, 'works seamlessly with any helpdesk', and 'Your team stays on Salesforce'. It can also run standalone through the Fin Agent API. Two-way sync is only implied, by transfers into the preferred inbox and updates to external systems, and the Zendesk and Salesforce evidence is article titles only. missing for 10: explicit documentation of bidirectional ticket/context sync mechanics, detailed Zendesk/Salesforce integration content beyond titles, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, the agent runs inside my existing helpdesk — Zendesk, Salesforce, Intercom — or standalone, syncing tickets and context both ways

citations.quote: Fin AI Agent works seamlessly with any helpdesk, including Salesforce, HubSpot, and more.
integrations with Intercom or your existing helpdesk
Transfers to agents directly in preferred Inbox
Takes action to update external systems
Fin can be accessed programmatically via an API.
